g3-implement.imperative: STEP 1 - PRE-REGISTER. Write TRIPWIRES.md naming one falsifiable prediction per deletion, and COMMIT IT BEFORE any deletion. Git history is the timestamp proof: it is tamper-evident and needs no clock (the episode writer is deliberately clock-free). Do NOT file episodes yet - `create` requires all five agent-supplied kinds including observed-behavior, and inventing an observation before observing is exactly what this pathway forbids (critic finding 5). STEP 2 - DELETE, in a separate commit: the 86-word dead-path block in COMMANDER_SPINE tasks.context.imperative; the 86-word block in EXECUTE_PLAN tasks.e0-context.imperative; and retarget the pathless 'the current map' phrasing at context and plan. CRITICAL: the phrase 'no docs/agents/ overlay at all' occurs TWICE in tasks.context.imperative - the FIRST is the load-bearing substitute-and-record rule and MUST SURVIVE; delete only the second, inside the dead-path block. STEP 3 - RUN, concretely: materialize a fresh Commander spine in THIS repo via init_work_area.py under a scratch work-id, drive it through init and context with the engine, and capture the engine's own output. Record each observed outcome in .agent-work/issue-304/TRIPWIRE_OUTCOMES.md against the pre-registered prediction by name, citing the pre-registration commit SHA. STEP 4 - FILE the episodes via scripts/apply_episode_delta.py (the ONLY write path), each with expected-behavior = the pre-registered prediction and observed-behavior = what actually happened. STEP 5 - Add tests/test_prose_deletions.py asserting the deleted strings are ABSENT from the shipped templates AND that the surviving substitute-and-record rule is still PRESENT. STEP 6 - Write the corpus-size / per-role-surface trend snapshot to .agent-work/issue-304/TREND_SNAPSHOT.md, derived from git, with a stated schema. ADMIRAL AMENDMENT 2: the snapshot MUST NAME ITS CONSUMER and its successor. The consumer is THE NEXT SNAPSHOT - a baseline's whole purpose is a comparison that does not exist yet, which is legitimate unlike an unread report. State that explicitly, state WHEN the second snapshot is expected (at epic-298 close), and state the retire-if-unread rule: a baseline with no scheduled successor is decoration wearing a measurement's clothes. Same standard already applied to the REPORT-ONLY ordering audit, whose consumer is commander-299's rig during this epic and NOBODY after it.
